Welcome to My Homepage.

Hi! I am Zeqi Wu. I am currently a visiting Ph.D. student at the School of Management and Economics, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen, under the supervision of Prof. Chunrong Ai. I am also a Ph.D. candidate at the Institute of Statistics and Big Data, Renmin University of China, advised by Prof. Zheng Zhang. I received my B.S. in Statistics from Xiamen University in 2023.

Research interests

Causal inference, semiparametric and nonparametric estimation and inference, machine learning, policy evaluation and learning, and network econometrics. View research →
